Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At ProTools, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website and services.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.content: We collect information you provide directly to us when using our tools (e.g., CV data, invoice details). However, most of our tools (like PDF tools, CV Generator) process data locally on your device. We do not store your personal files on our servers.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Information
section2.content: We use the information to provide and improve our services. For example, to generate your CV or invoice. We may also use non-personal data for analytics to understand how our site is used.

section3.title: 3. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
section3.content: We use cookies to enhance your experience, such as remembering your language preference. We also use third-party tracking tools like Google Analytics to analyze website traffic.

section4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
section4.content: Our service may contain links to third-party websites or services (e.g., Google AdSense) that are not owned or controlled by ProTools. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third parties.

section5.title: 5. Data Security
section5.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your data. However, please be aware that no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

section6.title: 6. Contact Us
section6.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at faska2002elouaaziki@gmail.com.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using ProTools.

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: By accessing or using our website, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you disagree with any part of the terms, you may not access the service.

section2.title: 2. Use of Services
section2.content: Our tools are provided for personal and professional use. You agree not to misuse our services or help anyone else do so.

section3.title: 3. Intellectual Property
section3.content: The content, features, and functionality of ProTools are and will remain the exclusive property of ProTools and its licensors.

section4.title: 4. Disclaimer
section4.content: Our services are provided 'as is'. ProTools makes no warranties, expressed or implied, regarding the accuracy or reliability of the tools.

section5.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
section5.content: In no event shall ProTools be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages arising out of your use of the service.

section6.title: 6. Changes to Terms
section6.content: We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms at any time. Your continued use of the service after any changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.

About.title: About ProTools
About.subtitle: Empowering professionals with next-generation AI tools.
About.intro: ProTools Faska is a comprehensive platform designed to streamline your workflow. Whether you're a freelancer, student, or business owner, our free tools help you achieve more in less time.
About.feature1Desc: Access all premium tools without any hidden costs or subscriptions.
About.feature2Desc: Your data is processed locally tailored for maximum security.
About.feature3Desc: Leverage the latest AI technology to automate complex tasks.
About.feature4Desc: Available in multiple languages to support users worldwide.
About.missionText1: To provide high-quality, professional tools that are accessible to everyone, regardless of their budget or location.
About.missionText2: We believe that technology should be an enabler, not a barrier. That's why we're committed to building open, privacy-focused utilities that respect your data and your time.
